geometry.polygon: square standing into a vertical line
geometry.description: Four corners of each foot make the earth-square. The stacked body is one mountain-line from sole to crown.

reaction.name: Earth recognizes the human
reaction.note: Yogic metaphor. Not a laboratory protocol.

breath.name: Earth breath
breath.inhale: length climbs the inner line from arches to crown
breath.exhale: weight pours into four corners of each foot
breath.pause: half-second after exhale — the mountain listens
breath.bandha: whisper of mula bandha on exhale only
breath.mantra_on_breath: LAM rides the exhale through the bones of the feet

enter_keys: four corners: big-toe mound, little-toe mound, inner heel, outer heel
pelvis a bowl that spills neither way

attention.instruction: Do not watch the whole body. Watch the feet until the earth answers.

ways_to_perfection: Become the mountain that does not leave.

octaves.refine: even weight, three body-planes stacked, jaw unclenched
octaves.dissolve: you are the mountain, not a person doing Mountain

guardian.name: MERU
guardian.voice: quiet granite with a child’s curiosity
guardian.opening_line: Before every journey, the earth must recognize you.

safety: Dizziness: stand near a wall. Knee pain: secret micro-bend. Pregnancy: hip-width feet.
close_the_door: Soften the knees. Feel the floor as ordinary ground, which is still sacred.
vbt_companion: The still point between two breaths, while standing.
cartoon_beats: Toes lift like little flags, then plant. Four golden dots under each foot.
Crown opens a thin white thread to the sky.
LAM appears as a low red drum under the pelvis.
The yogi is still. The doorway clicks open.
